tags.combat-roll-bonus: Adds a positive modifier to combat rolls (space or ground) of your units or a chosen player's units. magnitude = the +N.
tags.combat-roll-penalty: Applies a negative modifier to combat/bombardment/space cannon die rolls, usually the opponent's. magnitude = N (positive number).
tags.extra-dice: Lets units roll additional dice in combat or another roll. magnitude = number of extra dice.
tags.reroll: Allows re-rolling dice (combat, exploration, or other rolls).
tags.sustain-damage: A unit has or gains the SUSTAIN DAMAGE keyword.
tags.sustain-grant: Gives other units/ships the ability to sustain damage, or cancel a hit by sustaining.
tags.sustain-deny: Prevents units from using SUSTAIN DAMAGE or from being repaired.
tags.cancel-hit: Cancels or ignores hits produced against your units, or prevents a unit from being destroyed.
tags.pre-combat-hits: Produces hits at the start of / before combat rolls (ambush, assault cannon, first strike), or destroys units at combat start.
tags.assign-hits-control: Lets a player choose which units take hits, or forces/limits how hits are assigned.
tags.anti-fighter-barrage: A unit has or enhances ANTI-FIGHTER BARRAGE.
tags.space-cannon: A unit has, grants, or enhances SPACE CANNON (including offense/defense variants and ranged use).
tags.space-cannon-immunity: Units or players are protected from SPACE CANNON hits, or the effect is reduced.
tags.bombardment: A unit has, grants, or enhances BOMBARDMENT.
tags.planetary-shield: A unit has/grants PLANETARY SHIELD or prevents bombardment.
tags.ignore-planetary-shield: Units ignore or remove PLANETARY SHIELD.
tags.destroy-units: Destroys units outright (not via combat hits). magnitude = number destroyed if stated.
tags.capture-units: Captures enemy units into your own capture area / holds units for ransom.
tags.unit-revival: A destroyed unit returns to play, is placed back from reinforcements, or is replaced after destruction.
tags.unit-replacement: Replaces a unit with a different (usually better/other) unit from reinforcements.
tags.negate-ability: Disables, cancels or nullifies another card, unit ability, technology, or faction ability.
tags.combat-avoidance: Prevents or skips a combat, or prevents movement into a system to avoid combat.
tags.retreat-control: Grants, forces, or restricts retreats / retreat destinations.
tags.combat-stat-change: Changes a unit's combat value/hit threshold (e.g. combat value improved or set to a number).
tags.post-combat-trigger: Triggers an effect after a combat round or on winning/losing combat.
tags.move-bonus: Adds to the move value of ships (or sets it). magnitude = +N.
tags.move-through-ships: Ships may move through or ignore other players' ships / blockades.
tags.anomaly-movement: Ships may enter, move through, or are protected in anomalies (asteroid field, nebula, supernova, gravity rift).
tags.adjacency-grant: Treats systems/units as adjacent that normally are not, or creates adjacency.
tags.wormhole: Interacts with wormholes (counting, treating as wormhole, creating wormhole tokens).
tags.capacity-bonus: Increases ship capacity or lets units not count against capacity. magnitude = N.
tags.fleet-limit-bonus: Raises the fleet pool / non-fighter ship limit per system, or exempts units from it.
tags.move-without-transport: A unit may move without being carried, or be carried in unusual ways.
tags.relocate-units: Moves units outside a normal move (teleport/swap/redeploy, move out of turn, transfer between systems).
tags.extra-activation: Allows an additional activation, tactical action, or taking another action/turn.
tags.restrict-activation: Prevents players from activating systems or limits where tactical actions can occur.
tags.restrict-movement: Prevents or limits movement of ships/units (e.g. cannot move into a system).
tags.place-units-free: Places units from reinforcements without paying (not via production).
tags.produce-units: Produces units outside normal production timing, or grants a production action.
tags.production-bonus: Increases or adds PRODUCTION capacity / units produced. magnitude = N.
tags.cost-reduction: Reduces the cost of units, technologies or other purchases. magnitude = amount.
tags.production-unit: A unit has the PRODUCTION keyword.
tags.place-structure: Places or builds structures (space dock, PDS) or changes where they may be placed.
tags.gain-trade-goods: Gain trade goods. magnitude = amount if fixed.
tags.gain-commodities: Gain or replenish commodities. magnitude = amount if fixed.
tags.convert-commodities: Convert commodities to trade goods or modify commodity conversion.
tags.commodity-value-bonus: Changes your commodity value / maximum commodities. magnitude = N.
tags.steal-trade-goods: Take trade goods or commodities from another player.
tags.give-trade-goods: Give trade goods/commodities to others (including as a cost).
tags.spend-trade-goods: Requires spending trade goods as a cost to use an effect. magnitude = cost.
tags.trade-goods-as-resources: Trade goods count as resources/influence or are worth more when spent.
tags.resources-bonus: Increases resources of planets or available resources. magnitude = N.
tags.influence-bonus: Increases influence of planets or available influence. magnitude = N.
tags.gain-planet: Take control of a planet or gain a planet card.
tags.protect-planet: Prevents planets from being taken, invaded, exhausted or having units removed.
tags.remove-command-token: Remove command tokens from board or from players' pools.
tags.place-command-token: Place command tokens on the board or on cards.
tags.strategy-pool-use: Spends or interacts with tokens from the strategy pool as a cost or resource.
tags.no-token-cost: Allows an action/secondary ability without spending a command token.
tags.discard-opponent-card: Make another player discard cards, or take/steal cards from their hand.
tags.look-at-hidden-info: Look at hidden cards, objectives, or decks (hand, secret objective, top of deck).
tags.gain-secret-objective: Draw, gain, or swap secret objectives.
tags.score-objective-help: Helps score, ignore requirements of, or gives conditions to score objectives.
tags.gain-victory-point: Directly grants or removes victory points. magnitude = VP.
tags.gain-promissory: Gain, take, steal, or give promissory notes.
tags.gain-relic: Gain a relic or relic fragment.
tags.explore: Explore planets/frontiers or draw exploration cards.
tags.gain-attachment: Attaches tokens/attachments to planets or systems.
tags.research-free: Gain or research a technology outside of normal research, or free/discounted research.
tags.tech-theft: Copy, take, or use another player's technology.
tags.tech-specialty-use: Interacts with tech specialties, technology colors, or counts technologies owned.
tags.vote-bonus: Gives additional votes or changes voting power. magnitude = N.
tags.vote-restrict: Prevents voting or restricts how votes can be cast.
tags.agenda-predict: Predict or choose an agenda outcome.
tags.agenda-cancel: Cancel, discard, redo or replace an agenda or its outcome.
tags.agenda-manipulation: Look at, reorder, reveal or otherwise manipulate the agenda deck / revealed agendas.
tags.elect-outcome: Effect of electing a player/planet/etc. and what they gain or lose.
tags.law-permanent: A law/persistent rule change that remains in play.
tags.strategy-card-manipulation: Exchange, take, change or restrict strategy cards or their abilities/initiative.
tags.initiative-change: Changes initiative order or turn order.
tags.transaction: Alters transactions: who can trade, what can be traded, or timing.
tags.deal-enforcement: Binding promises or commitments between players (promissory pledges, forced compliance, ceasefire).
tags.share-ability: Lets you (or others) use another player's card/ability/unit as if your own (alliance, commander sharing).
tags.exhaust: Card must be exhausted to use.
tags.purge: Card is purged (removed from the game) after use.
tags.ready-card: Ready exhausted cards, leaders or components.
tags.timing-action: Triggered as an ACTION (taken on your turn as the action).
tags.timing-start-turn: Triggers at the start of a turn, round, or phase beginning.
tags.timing-end-turn: Triggers at the end of a turn, round, or phase.
tags.timing-combat: Triggers during or around a combat.
tags.timing-passive: Static always-on effect with no trigger.
tags.timing-reaction: Reaction triggered by another player's action or event.
tags.requires-adjacent-units: Effect conditional on units being adjacent / in or near a system.
tags.requires-planets-controlled: Effect conditional on controlling planets/planet types/count.
tags.requires-units-present: Effect conditional on having particular units in a system or on a planet.
tags.requires-home-system: Effect tied to your home system, home planets, or another player's home.
tags.requires-more-than-opponent: Effect conditional on having more/less of something than an opponent.
tags.leader-unlock-condition: Leader that has an unlock requirement (commanders/heroes).
tags.faction-start-setup: Modifies setup, starting units, starting technologies, or components at game start.
tags.obj-control-planets: Objective: control a number/type of planets.
tags.obj-planet-traits: Objective: planet traits (cultural/hazardous/industrial) or planet attributes.
tags.obj-spend: Objective: spend resources, influence, trade goods or tokens.
tags.obj-combat: Objective: win combats, destroy units, or kill units.
tags.obj-hold-systems: Objective: occupy Mecatol Rex, home systems, or special systems.
tags.obj-tokens-cards: Objective: possess tokens, cards, relics, or trade goods.
tags.obj-wormholes-anomalies: Objective: wormholes, anomalies, or system types.
tags.obj-ownership-count: Objective: own a numeric count of components (units, planets, cards).
tags.game-structure-change: Alters game structure/rules (e.g. galactic event modifying rules).
tags.puppet-control: Controls another player's decisions, cards, or components (puppet).
tags.frontier-token: Concerns frontier tokens or exploration discovery.
tags.planetary-trait-bonus: Effect keyed to planet trait or attribute (legendary, cultural, hazardous, industrial).
tags.ground-force-effect: Directly affects infantry/ground forces (placing, killing, boosting, moving).
tags.ship-effect: Directly affects ships (placing, moving, killing, boosting).
tags.mech-effect: Directly affects mechs (deploy, boost, revive, mech ability).
tags.war-sun-effect: Directly affects war suns or flagships.
